data.title: Tile preview loses its 12px gap: refreshPreviews resets style.display, wiping inline display:grid

data.body: Found during PM-13 review. createTilePreview sets root.style.display='grid' (with 12px gap) inline; refreshPreviews in src/main.ts restores visibility with style.display='' which wipes that, so the swatch column stacks without its gap after the first mode switch. Fix direction: move display:grid/gap into a CSS class instead of inline styles (or toggle visibility via hidden attribute). Well-understood, backlog.
